excerpts.text: Ross was using Thomson Reuters’s headnotes as AI data to create a legal research tool to compete with Westlaw.
It is undisputed that Ross’s AI is not generative AI (AI that writes new content itself).
Weighing them all together, I grant summary judgment for Thomson Reuters on fair use.
Because the AI landscape is changing rapidly, I note for readers that only non-generative AI is before me today.
